cause: Automatic SimControl backup had indeterminate UNIT. Native sim_ctrl_set_owner calls sim_ctrl_init_u3a8, which reads UNIT twice before sim_ctrl_copy overwrites the backup's copied fields. Passing tests cannot establish absence of this C++ undefined behavior.
repair: Assign backup.unit = sc.unit immediately after construction and before owner/init. Existing fillGeneral has already required source UNIT1 or2 on this supported path. Retain all field-aware deep copy, repeated fill and restore ordering.
original_qualification: Retained GUI140ecb340 calls GUI1408d3bc0 constructor, GUI1408d3cd0 owner/init, then GUI1408df7b0 copy. That selection does not establish the original stack UNIT value. This repair supplies defined adapter/native initialization; it is not a claim that original GUI constructor bytes or incidental stack contents match it. Shared native model sources remain untouched.

bounded_initialization_audit.owner: Constructor assigns owner=null; set_owner installs actual already initialized 3D DB_STEP_DATA before all dimension queries.
bounded_initialization_audit.scalar_reads: Names/step counts/limits/iteration/misc init write their target fields before dependent use. update_u240 reads DSMAX and DTTYPE.ndim after their assignments. FRQNCY dimensions are assigned before multiplication/allocation. Environment init's UNIT branch is the only preexisting SimControl scalar dependency identified before deep copy.
bounded_initialization_audit.owned_members: DYNARY constructor sets counts, arrays and owned pointer before dynary_init/free; templates set shape before calloc. Furnace constructor initializes list head/tail/count and name bytes before clear/setup; newly appended DYNARY nodes are constructed, and shape/value allocations are initialized before default fill/conversion. Furnace conversion's unit singleton is inline UnitGlobals g_units{} and has defined initialization, separate from backup UNIT.
bounded_initialization_audit.untouched_storage: DYNARY padding+5c/+70 and 3D-excluded 2D-only SimControl fields are not initialized wholesale, and are not read by this bounded ctor/init path. No memset/whole-struct assignment introduced. No claim of every native model field or arbitrary later operation being initialized.
bounded_initialization_audit.copy_boundary: First sim_ctrl_copy reads destination ownership, constructed table storage and source fields; destination scalars are stores. Native dynary_copy/alloc only read constructed destination arrays/counts/shape; original field-aware omissions remain. Source model completeness remains the existing loaded-state/profile requirement.
